name: Paul Fellows
title: Psychologist
practice: Mind Heart & Soul Psychology (at WellSpace Psychology)
description: Registered psychologist with a particular focus on sex and relationship therapy, supporting the impact of stress, trauma, or life changes on relationships and sexual connection. Affirming, inclusive, and sex-positive care for people from LGBTIQA+ communities; my practice is kink- and fetish-friendly and works with consensual non-monogamy and polyamory. Modalities include IFS & Parts work, Schema Therapy and Somatic Psychotherapy.
specialties: sex therapy, relationship therapy, LGBTIQA+, kink-friendly, non-monogamy, schema therapy, IFS/parts work, trauma, psychosexual therapy

name: Natalie Miller
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I'm especially passionate about working with the LGBTQIA+ community. Experience with trauma, personality disorders, self-harm and more; I use various therapeutic approaches including Schema Therapy, ACT, Interpersonal Therapy, CBT and DBT.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, schema therapy, trauma, personality disorders, DBT

name: Paul Byrne
title: Psychologist
description: I am a queer psychologist who wishes to recognise that bigger systems impact our mental wellbeing... It is part of my personal liberation to facilitate queer people in making the very best of their lives. I am trained in CBT, DBT and EMDR.

name: Ann Marie Crotty
title: Psychologist
description: Queer/Trans affirming Psychologist based in the Inner North/Fitzroy. Over 10 years' experience working with Q-munity and LGBTQ organisations in substance use (including chemsex), DFV/healthy relationships and sexuality/gender identity and mental health issues such as anxiety, depression, stress and trauma.
specialties: queer/trans affirming, LGBTQ, chemsex, AOD, family violence, sexuality, gender identity, trauma

name: Cindy Hsiao
title: Educational & Developmental and Clinical Psychologist
description: Special interests in working with individuals who are neurodivergent, from culturally and racially marginalised groups, LGBTQIA+, international students, newly arrived migrants, experiencing chronic health conditions, and experiencing trauma.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, neurodivergent, culturally and racially marginalised, trauma

name: Johannes Hanekom
title: Counselling Psychologist
description: Experience with anxiety, depression, emotional regulation difficulties, trauma, grief and more. He has a special interest in working with men and the LGBTQIA+ community, drawing on CBT, ACT, DBT and mindfulness.

name: Mark Camilleri
title: Psychologist
description: After concluding my time at the Royal Children's Hospital... specialisations: LGBTIQA+ Affirming Support; Trans, Gender Diverse, & Non-Binary Support for young people and families; Intellectual Disability (relationships and sexuality education); Faith and Sexuality intersectional navigation.
specialties: LGBTIQA+, trans and gender diverse young people, non-binary, families, sexuality, intellectual disability, faith and sexuality

name: Dr Brett Quayle
title: Psychologist
description: Structured, evidence-based space designed for gay men who have mastered the 'Performance of Being OK'... Identity Integrity: deconstructing minority stress, internalised beliefs; relational security, attachment anxiety and nervous system regulation.
specialties: gay men, LGBTIQ, minority stress, perfectionism, attachment
